title: Rab Rakha Bhain Da Veera Shala Watan Te Khairi Aveen
body:
Rab Rakha Bhen Da Veera, Shala Watan Tay Khairi Aveen
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis Wailay Bhen Di, Tenu Yaad Sataway, Koi Khat Beemar Nu Paaveen
<<DIVIDER>>
Joray Shagna Day Main, Kitthay Qasid Nu Veer Bhaijaangi
Joray Shagna Day Main, Tenu Rab Da, Waasta, Satveen Nu Tu Aakay,
Ay Joray Aap Le Javeen
<<DIVIDER>>
Har Azaan Ton Baad, Tere Naa Di Karaangi Tasbeeh Mai
Har Azaan Ton Baad, Tu Karbal, Jaandeya, Fairhist Chon Parh Ke,
Mere Naa Nu Seenay Laveen
<<DIVIDER>>
Tenu Phupiyan Nay Jadon, Vich Karbal Day Sehray Laanay Nay
Tenu Phupiyan Nay Jadon, Koi Jaanji, Bhaijh Kay, Watna Wal Veeraa,
Menu Apnay Kol Bulaveen
<<DIVIDER>>
Mar Jawan Jay Mein, Teray Waday Di Shaam Ton Pehlaan.
Mar Jawan Jay Mein, Fir Aakay, Veerna, In Ravaan Utay Tu,
Meri Soni Qabar Banaveen
